sup:70140.text:
Hello,

Thank you for your enquiry. Please find our Angebot below. We are very excited about the opportunity to work together with Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH and to prove ourselves as a reliable partner for your business!

For our offer, we can propose a price of €47.00 per unit, alongside a quality commitment of 6400 ppm. 

Please note that this offer stays valid for 30 days. We are eager to show you what we can do and hope this initial quote meets your expectations. Let us know if you have any questions at all.

Kind regards
Marek Lis
Export Manager, Odlewnia Kalwisz Sp. z o.o.

Hello,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. Hello, thanks for the 15,900 pcs volume and promising to pay on time, we really need that. We checked the index change data you cited; it holds and we took it into account. We also checked the quality record data you cited; it holds and we took it into account. 

The power index drop doesn't do much for us, but we want to make a deal. We see your figures, but we cannot give up margin right now. Faster payment would help us more than anything. Material accounts for about 30 % of our cost; more detail we do not share. We don't have a cost breakdown to send, but we can do €46.50 for 1500 ppm and 0 chargebacks. 

So our offer is a price of €47.00 per unit, a quality commitment of 300 ppm, a chargeback of €0.00 per complaint. Alternatively, we offer a price of €46.50 per unit, a quality commitment of 1500 ppm, a chargeback of €0.00 per complaint. This offer stays valid for 30 days.

Kind regards
Marek Lis
Export Manager, Odlewnia Kalwisz Sp. z o.o.
